description: This file defines a 'HikariDataSourceFactory' class that provides a method to create a new 'HikariDataSource' using a given configuration. It is part of the database infrastructure in the Fineract project and acts as a factory for data source objects using the Hikari connection pool.

classes.name: HikariDataSourceFactory
classes.description: A Spring component that provides a factory method to create HikariDataSource instances using provided configuration.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a new HikariDataSource instance configured with the provided HikariConfig.
